entries.name: WATCHBASE_API_KEY
entries.description: The API key of a WatchBase datafeed account, sent as the key query parameter to list brands and watches and read each watch's specs. The Data Feed API only gives data, so the key can only read; each watch read spends DataFeed credits. The connector only ever sends GET requests and never puts the request URL in a log or error.
howToGet: Sign up for a datafeed account on WatchBase and buy DataFeed credits: one credit is one cent, and each watch read costs US$0.25. The feed has no images.
WatchBase gives the account its API key. Copy it straight into the host's secret store.
Never paste it into chat, an issue or a URL you share: the key travels in the request URL.

entries.name: WATCHBASE_BRANDS
entries.description: The watch brands to read, by WatchBase brand name or BrandID, comma or newline separated, up to 50. Every watch of each brand is read once, so each brand costs its number of watches times US$0.25.
howToGet: List the brands the store sells or buys, as WatchBase names them. A name WatchBase doesn't list stops the sync with that name, so it can be corrected.

entries.name: WATCHBASE_MAX_WATCHES
entries.description: The most watches one sync reads, from 1 to 10000; 200 (US$50 of credits) when unset. A sync that reaches it stops, and the next one goes on from there.
howToGet: Pick what one sync may spend: each watch read costs US$0.25 in DataFeed credits.
